# Data Dictionary (schema 1.1.0)

Every record in `thru_hiker_survey_dataset.json` / `.csv` has these columns, in this order.
Numbers are stored in imperial units; columns listed under "Metric copy" hold the same value in metric.

The stored data and the public files are identical: answers are coarsened before they are saved
(see "Privacy protection" below), and exact dates, exact age, country, free text and the
submission time are never stored.

The first column is `schemaVersion`: the schema the record was collected under (see the changelog below).

| Column | Question shown in the survey | Type | Values / units | ML role | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `consentVersion` |  | string (free text) |  | Metadata | Not asked. Version of the consent text the hiker agreed to before starting. |
| `trail` | "Which long-distance trail did you hike?" | string (category) | `PCT`, `AT`, `CDT`, `CT`, `AZT`, `JMT`, `TRT`, `PNT`, `Long Trail`, `Hayduke`, `FT`, `IAT`, `BMT`, `SHT`, `CDS`, `TMB`, `WHW`, `GR20`, `GR10`, `HEX`, `VIA`, `AV1`, `KUN`, `C2C`, `TA`, `Other North America`, `Other Europe`, `Other` | Categorical feature | Required. |
| `hikeYear` | "Year of the hike" | integer | 1970 – current year + 1 | Temporal feature | Required. |
| `direction` | "Direction" | string (category) | `NOBO`, `SOBO`, `EABO`, `WEBO`, `CW`, `CCW`, `TO_SANTIAGO`, `FROM_SANTIAGO`, `Flip-flop`, `Section` | Categorical feature | Required. NOBO/SOBO on most trails; EABO/WEBO on east-west trails, CW/CCW on loops, TO_SANTIAGO/FROM_SANTIAGO on the Camino; the "Other" trail choices offer NOBO/SOBO and EABO/WEBO. |

| `startWeek` | "Start date" | string (free text) |  | Temporal feature | Not asked. ISO 8601 week of the start date (e.g. 2025-W16). Null when datePrecision is "month". |
| `startMonth` | "Start date" | string (free text) |  | Temporal feature | Not asked. Month of the start date (YYYY-MM). |
| `endWeek` | "End date (finish, or the day you left)" | string (free text) |  | Temporal feature | Not asked. ISO 8601 week of the end date. Null when datePrecision is "month". |
| `endMonth` | "End date (finish, or the day you left)" | string (free text) |  | Temporal feature | Not asked. Month of the end date (YYYY-MM). |

| `unknownAnswers` |  | string[] (categories) | `totalElevationGainFt`, `trailSpending`, `gearCost`, `maxHeavyLoadLbs`, `shoePairsUsed`, `averageCalories`, `week1DailyMiles`, `week2DailyMiles`, `week3DailyMiles`, `week4DailyMiles`, `totalNeroDays`, `hoursSleepPerNight`, `injuryMilestoneMiles` | Missing-data indicator | Optional; null when not answered. Names of the questions answered "Don't know" (their value is null). A null that is not listed here means the question did not apply. |

Validation also rejects: a ramp-up week count that does not match the dates, an end date before the start date, a start date more than one year
from the hike year, a max load below the base weight, more zero + nero days than days on
trail, an end date in the future, and distances/dates that imply more than 100 mi/day.

In the CSV, list columns (`injuryLocations`, `illnessTypes`, `priorInjuryAreas`, `deadlineReasons`,
`unknownAnswers`) are `;`-separated.

## Privacy protection

- Dates are stored as ISO weeks (`startWeek`, `endWeek`) and months (`startMonth`, `endMonth`).
- Popular trails (week precision): `PCT`, `AT`, `CDT`, `CT`, `AZT`, `JMT`, `Long Trail`, `CDS`, `TMB`, `WHW`, `GR20`, `TA`.
- All other trails (month precision): `TRT`, `PNT`, `Hayduke`, `FT`, `IAT`, `BMT`, `SHT`, `GR10`, `HEX`, `VIA`, `AV1`, `KUN`, `C2C`, `Other North America`, `Other Europe`, `Other`.
  On these, `startWeek`/`endWeek` are null, `totalDistanceMiles` is rounded to 10 mi, `daysOnTrail` to whole
  weeks, and `averageDailyMiles` is computed from the rounded values.
- Asked columns list the exact question; the form shows the unit the hiker chose (imperial or metric).
- Age at the start of the hike is stored as `ageBand`: one `20-and-under` band, then `21-24` and 5-year bands; country as `homeRegion`.
- Derived values (`daysOnTrail` on popular trails, `monthsSinceTrail`, the ramp-up check) are computed from the
  exact answers before those are discarded.

A `null` value means the question did not apply, unless the column is listed in
`unknownAnswers`, which means the hiker answered "Don't know".

## Changelog

### 1.1.0 (2026-10-17)

- totalBudget is replaced by two questions: trailSpending (on and during the trail, without travel to and from it and without gear) and gearCost (all gear the hiker carried, including gear they already owned). Add them up for the old total.
- The three records collected under 1.0.0 were moved to the new columns with the split their hikers gave.
- Consent version 2: the privacy page lists the gear cost.

### 1.0.0 (2026-10-17)

- First public version.
